N2 and N3 each deal two hits (attackHitmarks: N2=[17,37], N3=[15,21]); per recipe, swap reflects the last hitmark and N2/N3 N-cancel frames are AnimationLength (46/53) so omitted.
Charged attack is 3 rapid hits (chargeHitmarks=[42,49,56]) with a single chargeFrames map per recipe; the swap/D/J/E/Q/N values reflect cancel windows opening after the final hitmark.

abilities.name: Feathermoon Ring (N follow-up)
abilities.description: When pressed during the Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance leap-back window (66f after a successful Detect hit), N fires Feathermoon Ring instead of a normal attack — three Anemo hits at frames 38, 62, 85. Schema-typed as a skill (not a normal) because gcsim categorises it as `SkillState` with elemental-art ICD/scaling, even though the input is N.
_curatorNotes: gcsim categorisation: pressing N while leapBackStatus is active calls reathermoonRings() which returns action.SkillState with AttackTagElementalArt. So this entry is `abilityType: "skill"` despite the N input — more truthful than a normal-attack entry that would inherit normal-attack ICD.

Three hit frames from gcsim ringHitmarks=[38, 62, 85]; not authored as hits[] because SkillAbility's schema only carries a single FrameMap. Reviewer may extend the schema to support per-hit timing on stance-fired skill abilities.

Cooldown 0: gcsim's reathermoonRings does not call SetCD. ActionReady override returns true for E during leapBackStatus regardless of base skill CD — the in-stance follow-up bypasses the 16s skill cooldown. Same applies to the in-stance E variant below.
A4 (anemo mastery): each ring hit gains FlatDmg += EM × 3.09. Scaling buff — value field omitted per recipe; reviewer to wire as BuffValue.scaling with scalingStat 'em'.

A1 (Four Sealing Divination Charms): if the parent Detect hit triggered an elemental absorption (Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo), each ring hit also fires a 'mixed' hit at 50% multiplier with the absorbed element (separate ICDGroup ICDGroupLanyanRingAttackMix, reset_timer=150). Recipe.md § 3.5 says don't author element-absorption-conditional damage; flagged here only.
C1 ("As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds") extra hits at frames [38, 64, 90] when the absorbed element is non-Anemo. Same A1-conditional logic; not modeled, flagged on the C1 entry.

Casting this ability ends leapBackStatus (gcsim DeleteStatus(leapBackStatus) at top of reathermoonRings). The schema's stance window does not have an explicit 'in-stance ability ends stance' field; reviewer to handle in parser. The 1.1s stance duration on the base skill makes the practical impact small.

abilities.name: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance

_curatorNotes: Shield authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10. ATK-scaling (unusual for shields) — verified gcsim shield.go shieldHP() = shieldAmt[TalentLvlSkill] × TotalAtk() + shieldFlat[TalentLvlSkill]. gcsim lanyan_gen.go shieldAmt[9]=4.97664 (→ scaling 497.664% ATK), shieldFlat[9]=2542.4312 (→ flat 2542.43). Cross-checks sidecar 'Shield DMG Absorption' 10th column '497.7% ATK+2542'.

Duration 12.5s fixed: gcsim shield.go genShield sets Expires = Core.F + 12.5*60; sidecar 'Shield Duration' row is a flat 12.5s at every level. durationType 'fixed' — each qualifying cast replaces the prior LanyanShield with a fresh 12.5s window (not a stack/refresh).
Target 'active': gcsim shield Tmpl Target=-1 (player-wide, protects the on-field character). Standard active-character shield.

Shield generates only on the Detect hit (gcsim leapBack() → genShield fired from the hit callback; miss path genShields only via the fallback task if no shield already exists). Modeled as onCast/skill per the corpus convention (cf. Diona 'forms a shield on hit'); the detect-hit conditionality is surfaced to the player via the ability caveat.
Shield element matches the A1-absorbed element (defaults to Anemo); shield Effect has no element field, so the element type is not modeled — noted here only.

abilities.description: Lan Yan strikes forward with a brief detect hitbox at frame 7. If it hits an enemy, she leaps backwards, generating a Shield of Safe Transport-style Anemo shield (12.5s, scales off ATK + flat) and entering a 66f window during which her next N or E press fires Feathermoon Ring instead. The detect-miss path skips the leap-back window and uses a faster cancel slice (skillMissFrames: swap=49, N=45, Q=46, D=47, J=47).
_curatorNotes: Stance opens conditionally on detect-hit only. Frames above are gcsim's skillHitFrames (post-hit) — the standard rotation case. Miss-path cancel slice (skillMissFrames): swap=49, N=45, Q=46, D=47, J=47. Not authored as a separate ability; reviewer to flag a caveat for missed-detect rotations.

Hold parameter (0–610): shifts the detect hitmark to 7+hold and adds +hold frames to all cancel times. cooldownStartDelay = 4+hold. Min-hold (hold=0, the standard use) is captured here; max-hold cancel ≈ 80+610 = 690 frames. Not modelled; flag for hold-aware rotations.

Shield authored 2026-07-12 as a shield Effect (see effects[]): 12.5s lifetime, ShieldHP = shieldAmt[talentLvl] × TotalAtk + shieldFlat[talentLvl] (ATK-scaling — verified gcsim shield.go shieldHP()). Shield element type matches the absorbed element (defaults to Anemo); element is not a shield-Effect schema field, so it's noted here only.

C2 ("Dance Vestments Billow Like Rainbow Jade"): on enemy hit by active char's normal attack while the shield is up, restores 40% of shield HP. ICD 2s. Not authored — schema has no 'on team-N hit while shield up' trigger; flagged on C2.
C6 ("Let Us Away on Sylphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"): Init() calls SetNumCharges(action.ActionSkill, 2), giving 2 skill charges at C6. Authored as chargeModifiers below.
Stance duration of 1.1s is gcsim's leapBackDuration (66 frames). terminatesOnSwap inferred from the BLOCKED-draft notes (stance is brief enough that this rarely matters in practice).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — in the modelled scenario. The tool's world is one stationary enemy you are engaging — every damage bar, every summon and every hit-gated effect in the corpus assumes the cast connects. The 12.5s shield bar is CORRECT for a landed cast, and the caveat's only content is "if you whiff, you get nothing", which is how the character works rather than something the screen gets wrong. Contrast Diona's kept shield caveat, which is about the drawn bar's LENGTH and absorption changing with paw count even when the cast lands. Category: kit-explanation.

chargeModifiers.source: C6: "Let Us Away on Sylphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"

abilities.name: Lustrous Moonrise
abilities.description: Lan Yan summons a moonrise that deals three instances of Anemo DMG to opponents in the targeting circle. Hits at frames 30, 46, 51. C4 fires a 60 EM team buff for 12s on cast.
_curatorNotes: 'grouping' tag added (capability sweep 2026-07-28): wiki Vacuum Field table lists Lustrous Moonrise as a genuine enemy-pulling vacuum (small enemies: radius 6m strength 4; large: strength 10) — same shape as Kazuha's Chihayaburu rows. gcsim burst.go models the 3 Anemo hits only (gcsim never models displacement, so its silence is not counter-evidence). Tag only; the pull is part of the burst's hit window, no timing invented.

Three hits at gcsim burstHitmarks=[30, 46, 51], all sharing the same AttackInfo (50U gauge anemo, ICDTagElementalBurst). Schema-typed as a single burst frames map per recipe; multi-hit timing flagged here.
J omitted: burstFrames = InitAbilSlice(100) // Q - Jump with no explicit ActionJump override — default 100 is AnimationLength, not a valid cancel frame.
A4 (Liquid Moon): each burst hit gains FlatDmg += EM × 7.74. Scaling buff — value field omitted per recipe; reviewer to wire as BuffValue.scaling with scalingStat 'em'.
C4 ("With Drakefalcon's Blood-Pearls Adorned"): on Q cast, all party members gain +60 EM for 12s. Authored on the C4 constellation entry.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't model pulling opponents together, which is all Lustrous Moonrise adds beyond its damage.

_curatorNotes: ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15 from genshin-db 5.2.13: the 2026-05 entry was hand-written with an invented name and curator-speak in place of the kit text; the mechanics (from gcsim) were right and are kept below.

Element absorption — gcsim asc.go `absorbA1`: a Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo check at the dash's hit; on a hit the shield converts and every Feathermoon Ring hit fires a 50% hit of that element on `ringHitmarks` [38, 62, 85] in its own ICD group (`ICDGroupLanyanRingAttackMix`). ⛔ Not authored — the schema has no element-absorption conditional, and recipe.md § 3.5 says flag, don't author per-element damage.
passives.description:
When the dash from the Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance hits a target, if it interacts with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, the Swallow-Wisp Shield will undergo Elemental Absorption, with the converted shield absorbing DMG from the corresponding element with 250% efficiency.
Additionally, if this use of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance causes the Swallow-Wisp Shield to undergo Elemental Absorption, the Feathermoon Rings that Lan Yan throws at her foes additionally deal Elemental DMG equal to 50% of the original in the corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
